query: SELECT tax_year, COUNT(*)::int AS n, COUNT(year_built)::int AS yb, COUNT(land_acres)::int AS la FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips = '48021' GROUP BY tax_year ORDER BY tax_year
incident: First apply accidentally ran on feat/s1-instrument-hardening (pre-P-78 merge); yb/la regressed to 8706/1598. Immediate re-run on 46e1a5a1 restored and net-positive vs before.
